label: Technical explanation
description: Explaining a concept, a design or a bug to another engineer. Design docs, wiki pages, review comments, answers in a thread.

label: README and docs
description: Public facing project writing. README intros, install steps, changelogs, API docs.

label: Academic or formal
description: Papers, reports, essays for a class, anything with a grade or a reviewer on the other end.

label: Essay or opinion
description: Blog posts, opinion pieces, longer personal writing where you argue for something.

label: Social posts
description: Public short form. X, Bluesky, Mastodon, LinkedIn, Reddit, HN comments.

label: Chat and DMs
description: Slack, Discord, Teams, texts. Team channels and one on one.

label: Email
description: Work and school email. Asking for something, replying, following up.

label: Code documentation
description: Docstrings, inline comments, commit messages and PR descriptions.
